candidates.summary: A command that draws nothing, used as a script, now raises the next atom into the script: x^\class{a}{} y renders as x^y, where the merge base showed the source
candidates.failure_scenario: An author writes x^\class{a}{} y (or x^\bigl\mathrm{} y, x^\middle\class{a}{} y). At 6c49f5420 conversion fails ('MathML encountered an unexpected error') and gnoweb shows the source. At 566ea8aa3 the new nil return at commands.go:373-376 (and the nil breaks at parse.go:109, 229) reach parse.go:298 'if child == nil { continue }', which keeps promotedProperties, so y becomes the superscript: <msup><mi>x</mi><mi>y</mi></msup>, err nil. Every sibling with an empty argument (\phantom{}, \mathop{}, \text{}, \cancel{}, \textcolor{red}{}, \substack{}) and {} itself render an empty superscript with y after it. The reader sees a different formula and nothing reports it. \mathrm{} as a script base lifts y at the base too. Fix: give a nil-drawing command an empty <mrow> when a script is pending, as parse.go:143-146 does for {}, or return an empty mrow for \class{a}{}.
candidates.verify_by: Copy tests/solo-finder-1-class-empty-script.go to gno.land/pkg/gnoweb/markdown/mathml/zz_solo1_class_empty_script_test.go and run go test -count=1 -run TestZZSolo1ClassEmptyScript -v ./gno.land/pkg/gnoweb/markdown/mathml/: expect FAIL with y inside <msup>; the same x^\class{a}{} y on a copy of the merge-base package returns the conversion error
candidates.evidence: head 566ea8aa3: 'x^\class{a}{} y err=<nil> <mrow><msup><mi>x</mi><mi>y</mi></msup></mrow>'; 'x^{} y err=<nil> <mrow><msup><mi>x</mi><mrow></mrow></msup><mi>y</mi></mrow>'; 'x^\bigl\mathrm{} y' and 'x^\middle\class{a}{} y' both '<msup><mi>x</mi><mi>y</mi></msup>'. Artifact run: '--- FAIL: TestZZSolo1ClassEmptyScript'. Base 6c49f5420 (package copied beside it): 'x^\class{a}{} y err=MathML encountered an unexpected error ... invalid math input'; 'x^\mathrm{} y err=<nil> <mrow><msup><mi>x</mi><mi>y</mi></msup></mrow>' (pre-existing member of the class).

candidates.summary: The \color fallback 'b.Unget(); return merror' after GetNextExpr cannot run once colorArgMissing answers first
candidates.failure_scenario: colorArgMissing (commands.go:589-601) returns false only when the next non-blank token, after an optional [..] whose closer lies before cellEnd, is a { matched within b. That { sits on cellEnd's walk, and opensGroup steps over it, so its closer lies inside the cell and switchExpressions.GetOptions plus GetNextExpr on the cut cell always succeed. The branch at commands.go:333-334 keeps a second merror path and an Unget nobody reaches, which a later reader has to reason about as live. Removing it touches commands.go:332-334: the 'if err == nil' guard becomes unconditional.
candidates.verify_by: Plant panic("zz") at commands.go:333 and run go test -count=1 ./gno.land/pkg/gnoweb/markdown/mathml/ plus a random corpus of \color, \color[RGB], \color{red}, \color[RGB]{1,2,3} mixed with [, ], {, }, &, \\ and comments: expect no conversion returning 'unexpected error' that the unplanted tree converts
candidates.evidence: Read: matched (tokenize.go:357-360) checks only MatchOffset > 0, not escaped, Value; the only unescaped Value '{' token is the tokCurly|tokOpen one from tokenize.go:100, and \right{, \middle{, \big{ lose tokOpen, so a matched { is always opensGroup. Round 3 claims row: TestZZGram 'found diffs=0 outside the \left} shape'.
